lessons.title: Annotate values and catch mistakes.
lessons.explain: Types are checked before your code runs. Annotate where it helps and let inference do the rest.
lessons.exercise: Assign a string to a number variable on purpose and read the compiler error.

lessons.title: Describe the shape of objects.
lessons.explain: An interface describes the shape of an object. Any value matching the shape is accepted.
lessons.exercise: Define a Product interface with name and price, then make an array of three.

lessons.title: Write one function for many types.
lessons.explain: Generics let one function work over many types while staying safe. T is a placeholder filled in at the call.
lessons.exercise: Write a generic last<T> function that returns the final item.

lessons.title: Model choices with union types.
lessons.explain: A union lists the allowed values and TypeScript narrows the type inside each branch.
lessons.exercise: Define a Shape union of circle and square and compute area with a switch.

capstone: A typed expense tracker with categories and monthly totals.
